record.question:
What was the primary trigger behind the devastating flash floods in northern Nepal on August 26,
    2026?
options: Continuous heavy monsoon cloudburst over Kathmandu
A massive rock–ice collapse/glacier detachment near the Nepal- China border
Artificial release of water from the Kulekhani reservoir
Failure of the Kosi High Dam due to heavy situation
